Class LegacyMcpClientStdioConfiguration

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.mcp.client.langchain4j.stdio.LegacyMcpClientStdioConfiguration
All Implemented Interfaces:
io.micronaut.core.naming.Named, McpClientConnectionConfiguration, McpClientStdioConfiguration
@Internal public final class LegacyMcpClientStdioConfiguration extends Object implements McpClientStdioConfiguration
The STDIO connection named "stdio" that the deprecated "langchain4j.mcp.client.transport.stdio.commands" property declares when the deprecated "micronaut.mcp.client.transport" property is "STDIO".
